2608.20844.title: TRACE: Agentic Catalog Enrichment with Multi-source Evidence Grounding
2608.20844.paper_summary: Product catalogs underpin search, discovery, and recommendation in e-commerce, yet they are often attribute-sparse: the attributes shoppers and downstream systems rely on are either buried in unstructured content such as titles and images or missing from the catalog altogether. Manually enriching e-commerce catalogs is impractical given their scale and rapid growth. This paper introduces TRACE, a novel framework for automated catalog attribute enrichment using agentic Large Language Models (LLMs). A ScoutAgent triangulates multimodal evidence across merchant catalogs, syndicated feeds, and identity-matched web search to propose candidate attribute values with supporting evidence, while a JudgeAgent verifies the proposed value for each attribute value against its supporting evidence and decides whether to publish it or route it to human review. On an offline human evaluation dataset, TRACE's proposed attribute values were 98.2% accurate at 74.7% attribute coverage. Deployed in production on an industry-scale catalog, TRACE increased impression-weighted enrichment coverage across four business verticals by 90.4%. An online experiment subsequently showed that surfacing the enriched attributes on the product detail page increased checkout conversion by 0.48%.
2608.20844.paper_summary_zh: 產品目錄支撐著電子商務中的搜索、發現和推薦，但它們往往屬性稀疏：購物者和下游系統依賴的屬性要麼埋藏在標題和圖像等非結構化內容中，要麼在目錄中完全缺失。考慮到電子商務目錄的規模和快速增長，手動豐富目錄是不切實際的。本文介紹了TRACE，一種使用自主大型語言模型（LLMs）進行自動目錄屬性豐富的新框架。ScoutAgent在商家目錄、聯合供應和身份匹配的網絡搜索之間三角測量多模態證據，以提出具有支持證據的候選屬性值，而JudgeAgent則根據其支持證據驗證每個屬性值的提議，並決定是否發布或將其路由至人工審查。在一個離線人類評估數據集中，TRACE提出的屬性值在74.7%的屬性覆蓋率下準確率達到98.2%。在行業規模的目錄中投入生產後，TRACE在四個業務垂直領域中提高了印象加權的豐富覆蓋率90.4%。隨後的一項在線實驗顯示，在產品詳細頁面上顯示豐富的屬性使結帳轉換率提高了0.48%。
